name: NexButton
author: wpcoder75

sections.description:
NexButton Elementor Plugin adds a custom button widget to Elementor, offering a variety of button styles with text and icon customization options.

Features:

  • Multiple button styles (Style 1 and Style 2)
  • Show/Hide button text and icon
  • Customizable button colors, backgrounds, and typography
  • Full control over button alignment, padding, margin, and border
  • Hover effects, including color and box-shadow transitions
  • Responsive design and controls for mobile devices

This plugin is easy to use and fully integrates into Elementor’s design workflow.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/nex-button directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Elementor Editor and find the “NexButton” widget under the Elementor’s “Widgets” panel.
  4. Drag and drop the widget into the desired section and start customizing.
sections.faq:
Can I change the button icon?

Yes, the plugin supports icon customization, allowing you to choose from a variety of icons provided by Elementor’s icon library.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes, the plugin provides responsive controls to ensure the button looks great on all devices.

Can I use it without Elementor?

No, this plugin is an extension for the Elementor page builder, so you need to have Elementor installed and activated.
